answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to post a refundable stake bond before transacting. Like a reef that only grows where coral commits to one place, an identity locking funds to a single address makes each fake copy expensive: a thousand sock puppets means a thousand bonds. Honest agents in a shared grove of services earn the bond back through fees, while detected duplicates lose theirs to slashing, so the attacker pays linearly per identity while the network’s nebula of small participants stays cheap to join honestly.
